data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 140.2m (2016: GBP 102.4m) is a deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of prior year claims reserves by GBP 19.1 million, representing a 5.9% increase relative to opening gross reserves. This was primarily driven by unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy, as well as adverse development on Property and Non-Marine Liability accounts for 2015 and prior years, and strengthening on legacy lines from 2013 and prior years due to late reporting. These adverse movements were partially offset by favourable developments across other classes, including Political Risks, Satellites, Marine Liability, and Energy. The year also saw significant losses from 2017 natural catastrophes like Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, and the Mexico earthquakes, impacting Property, Cargo, Marine, and Treaty classes.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle shows a total prior year development of +36.585m, which differs from the narrative statement of +19.1m. The narrative statement on page 30 is used as it explicitly refers to 'deterioration... to claims reserves established at the prior year end', which is a more direct measure of prior year development than the cumulative incurred claims in the triangle. Individual LOB movements are not quantified in the report.
